title: Integrate Studio runtime
root_cause: Agent Runtime exposes memory and handoff as blockers rather than broker-backed governed inputs.
source_requirement: Integrate Agency adapter, memory broker, handoff packet, model attachment, and placement into existing Studio execution.
implementation_steps: Resolve broker-backed memory and acknowledged handoffs during preview.
Carry immutable task/model/placement bindings to execution.
Emit unified outcome and cleanup receipt.
focused_tests: Agent preview and governed execution integration tests.
affected_tests: Studio run control, provider gateway, resource lifecycle, dashboard tests.
evidence_required: Contained end-to-end agent run with memory, handoff, model, placement, outcome, and cleanup.
rollback: Reinstate explicit blockers and stop before effects; preserve all receipts.
acceptance_criteria: Memory and handoff are resolved through canonical brokers.
Every effect remains Studio-admitted and fully receipted.
